name: hakka-build-your-own-devtools-example
description: A custom devtools panel built from hakka-browser/elements' six standalone custom elements (plus a hakka-browser/react variant) — real fetch/XHR traffic, no floating overlay.
//deps: hakka-browser isn't published yet, so it's a file: dep here (see examples/next-fullstack/package.json's own //overrides note for the full pattern). hakka-core is a direct dep too, not an override — hakka-browser only carries hakka-core as a devDependency (it gets bundled into hakka-browser's own dist), so nothing else in this tree pulls a conflicting resolution for it. react/react-dom are hakka-browser's optional peers, listed here in devDependencies (not dependencies) because only react.html's entry uses them — index.html's vanilla entry never imports React. Install with npm — bun lays file: deps out as per-file symlinks that Vite's dep pre-bundling doesn't always follow the same way npm's real copy does (next-fullstack and the other file:-dep examples all standardize on npm for this reason).
